policy: CR-DOC-READER-EXT-9R5A. Additive, versioned adjudications beside the pre-registered spec, which is unchanged. Results are scored under the original truth and, separately and labelled, under this adjudicated truth; earlier results are never rewritten. An adjudication concerns what a document appears to show only: it never establishes that any authorization was given, that a licence covers a use, or commercial clearance.
